english.note: Use this when someone keeps pursuing, pressing, or pestering someone relentlessly.

examples.english: They tenaciously pestered the girl and made her very uncomfortable.
examples.traditional: 佢死纏爛打咁追住個女仔，搞到人哋好困擾。
